response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer (~18 years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills, some cloud exposure (AWS CDK, Kubernetes), and recent hands-on work with MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling at re:cinq, which maps directly to a niche key technology in the role. However, his AI-specific experience appears to be roughly one to two years rather than the required 8+ years building production AI solutions, and the resume shows no explicit evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, data pipelines for unstructured data, or LLM evaluation/observability work. He could be a fit if the AI depth is stronger than the resume conveys, so a screening conversation is reasonable but not a clear yes.
strengths: Recent hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow frameworks
Deep full-stack engineering background (18+ years) with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud/Kubernetes deployment
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing (workshops, courses, conference talks) fitting customer-facing technical leadership
concerns: Falls well short of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions; GenAI experience is ~1 year
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/observability pipelines
Limited demonstrated enterprise customer-facing delivery or forward-deployed consulting experience

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG/vector DB and evaluation pipeline evidence
